properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for SIEM Solution should have 3 years retenstion
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure the organization have audit record retention controls that specifies retention periods of minimum 3 years, ensures compliance, and includes secure storage, retrieval, and review procedures. (Monitoring-IR-136).

metadata.Description:
Retention Policy Implementation
1. Configure retention policies across all cloud platforms to retain audit logs for a minimum of 3 years:
2. Implement automated lifecycle management policies to move audit logs to cost-effective cold storage after 180 days while maintaining the 3-year retention period.
